extensionName: TabTools - Close & Sort Tabs by Site
extensionDescription: Close tabs from the same website, sort tabs by site and remove duplicates to keep your browser organised.
recentNote: Closed with TabTools. Cleared when the browser closes.
keepNote: Pinned, playing and current tabs stay open.
web_privacyTitle:
Your tab data stays
in your browser.
web_siteBody: Open TabTools and click a site under Suggestions, or right-click within a web page and choose Close site tabs. This closes that site’s tabs across your regular windows, including the one you are on. Pinned tabs stay open unless you turn that off in Settings.
web_storeAria: {label} — opens the {store} in a new tab
web_structuredDescription: A free browser extension for closing tabs by site, sorting tabs, removing duplicates, and clearing inactive tabs.
web_close_tabs_from_the_same: Close tabs from the same website, sort tabs by site, and remove duplicates. TabTools is a free browser tab manager for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
web_tabtools_close_tabs_by_site: TabTools — Close Tabs by Site & Sort Your Tabs
web_close_tabs_by_site_sort: Close tabs by site, sort your tab bar, and clear duplicates with a free, open-source extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
web_clear_a_website_s_tabs: Clear a website’s tabs in one action, or sort your tab bar by site. TabTools also removes duplicates and clears inactive tabs in Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
web_free_to_use_no_account: Free to use. No account needed.
web_viewing_on_a_phone_or: Viewing on a phone or tablet? Open this page on your computer to add TabTools.
web_from_the_popup_or_right: from the popup or right-click menu
web_your_tab_list_stays_in: your tab list stays in your browser
web_clear_a_finished_task_bring: Clear a finished task, bring tabs from the same website together, or tidy repeated and inactive pages.
web_bring_tabs_from_the_same: Bring tabs from the same site together in your current window, with the sites you have open most placed first. Pinned tabs and tab groups stay where they are.
web_close_extra_copies_of_the: Close extra copies of the same page in one click. Two tabs are copies only when their whole addresses match. A pinned copy, a copy playing sound and the copy you are looking at always stay.
web_type_a_word_to_match: Type a word to list the tabs whose titles or addresses contain it, or a site such as youtube.com to list that site and its subdomains. Check the list, then press Enter or choose Close.
web_choose_an_inactivity_threshold_in: Click Inactive to see the tabs you have not used for a while, with the time since each was last used. Choose how long counts as inactive, from 30 minutes to 1 week, then close the ones listed. Pinned, playing and current tabs stay open.
web_light_and_dark_themes: Light, dark and system themes, with six accent colours
web_start_with_one_busy_site: Start with one busy site. Use the popup for site suggestions and sorting, or the right-click menu for a quick close.
web_open_the_chrome_firefox_or: Open the Chrome, Firefox, or Edge store page and add the free extension.
web_click_the_tabtools_icon_in: Click the TabTools icon in your browser’s extensions menu to see site suggestions and quick actions.
web_close_a_site_or_sort: Close a site or sort your tabs
web_click_a_site_under_suggestions: Click a site under Suggestions to close its tabs, or choose Sort tabs to bring tabs from the same site together.
web_the_tabtools_extension_processes_tab: The TabTools extension processes tab information on your device. Settings and cleanup statistics stay in your browser’s local storage. The extension has no accounts, analytics, advertising, or external database.
web_yes_tabtools_is_free_to: Yes. TabTools is free to use. No account is needed.
web_which_browsers_can_i_use: Which browsers can I use it with?
web_tabtools_is_available_for_chrome: TabTools is available for Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge. To add it on your computer, use the browser links on this page to open the right store.
web_how_do_i_close_tabs: How do I close tabs from the same website?
web_right_click_within_a_web: Right-click within a web page and choose “Close site tabs,” or open TabTools and click the site under Suggestions. This closes that site’s tabs across your regular windows, including the one you are on. Pinned tabs stay open unless you turn that off in Settings. You can also type a keyword or a site in the popup and close the tabs it lists.
web_can_i_remove_duplicates_or: Can I remove duplicates or clear inactive tabs?
web_yes_choose_close_duplicates_to: Yes. Choose Close duplicates to remove repeated pages. Click Inactive to review the tabs you have not used for a while, then close the ones listed. Nothing closes until you choose to.
web_does_tabtools_collect_or_share: Does TabTools collect or share my data?
web_the_extension_processes_tab_informat: The extension processes tab information locally and does not send it to the developer or third parties. Settings and cleanup statistics stay on your device. The working popup on this page runs in your browser on sample tabs and never reads your own. The browser stores this site links to have their own privacy policies.
web_use_undo_immediately_after_closing: After you close tabs from the TabTools popup, Undo appears there for a few seconds and brings them back. It goes when the popup closes. After that, use your browser’s recently closed tabs to reopen pages.
web_free_for_chrome_firefox_and: Free for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge
web_close_tabs_by_site_sort_2: Close tabs by site, sort your tab bar, and clear duplicates.
web_finalMobileNote: Open this page on your computer to add TabTools. You can view the store listings below.

web_demoHint: Try it. This popup closes and sorts the sample tabs above, not your own.
